_schema.id: namespace:slug — colon-separated, lowercase, dashes for word breaks
_schema.description: what the tag means / when to apply it
_schema.aliases: (optional, vendor tags only) surface forms the matcher should fold into this tag

_rules: Adding a tag is a deliberate commit. lint_articles.py rejects unknown tags on registry entries.
A registry entry should carry at most one stance:* and at most one genre:* tag.
Vendor and agency tags can repeat per article (an article can be vendor:flock + vendor:axon).
agency:* tags are a soft denormalization for filtering; the canonical link is article.agencies[] -> agency_registry.

vendor:flock.description: Article references Flock Safety products, contracts, or policies.

vendor:axon.description: Article references Axon (BWC, evidence.com, ALPR offerings).

vendor:fusus.description: Article references Fusus / RTIC integration platform.

vendor:vigilant.description: Article references Vigilant Solutions / Motorola ALPR.

vendor:motorola.description: Article references Motorola Solutions surveillance products.

policy:audit.description: Audit obligations, audit logs, audit cadence.

policy:sharing.description: Data-sharing arrangements between agencies / with private actors.

policy:hotlist.description: Hotlist sourcing, NCIC integration, custom hot lists.

incident:wrongful-stop.description: ALPR misread or stale data leading to a wrongful stop or detention.

incident:ice-cooperation.description: ALPR data flowing to ICE / federal immigration enforcement.

incident:misuse.description: Personnel misuse of ALPR (stalking, personal queries, etc.).

incident:data-breach.description: Breach or leak of ALPR data.

incident:false-positive.description: False match leading to enforcement action short of a stop.

legal:ag-bulletin.description: California (or other state) AG bulletin / guidance.

legal:ag-lawsuit.description: AG lawsuit against an agency (e.g., El Cajon).

scope:national.description: Article covers the issue at a national level, not a specific agency.

outcome:terminated.description: Agency canceled or let lapse a Flock (or other ALPR) contract.

outcome:restricted.description: Agency added new restrictions / policy constraints to a continuing contract.

outcome:reconsidering.description: Active council or public debate over the contract; no decision yet.

outcome:renewed.description: Agency explicitly renewed or expanded a contract despite controversy.

outcome:rejected.description: Agency declined to adopt ALPR / Flock in the first place.

stance:neutral.description: Straight news reporting; no editorial posture.

stance:critical.description: Frames ALPR / surveillance as a civil-liberties or accountability problem.

stance:supportive.description: Frames ALPR as an effective or appropriate law-enforcement tool.

stance:industry.description: Vendor or trade publication; promotional posture.

genre:investigative.description: Original reporting that surfaces non-public facts.

genre:explainer.description: Background / explanatory piece, not original reporting.

genre:press-release.description: Press release or thinly-rewritten press release.

genre:analysis.description: Analytical piece (think-tank report, policy brief, advocacy whitepaper).
